chapter.heading: A Plea for JusticeA Psalm of Asaph.
chapter.v:
God stands
in the congregation of the mighty;He judges among the gods. [Ps. 49:1; Is. 41:1; 43:9 b Deut. 32:1; Is. 1:2]

How long
will you judge unjustly,And show partiality to the wicked?Selah [Is. 13:5]

Defend the
poor and fatherless;Do justice to the afflicted and needy. [Joel 2:20; Amos]

Deliver the
poor and needy;Free them from the hand of the wicked. [Is. 14:12 g Rev.] [Ps. 102:26; Is. 13:13; Ezek. 32:7, 8; Joel 2:31; Matt. 24:29; 2 Pet. 3:10]

They do
not know, nor do they understand;They walk about in darkness;All the foundations of the earth are unstable.

I said,
“You are gods,And all of you are children of the Most High. [Zeph. 1:7]

But you
shall die like men,And fall like one of the princes.”

Arise, O
God, judge the earth;For You shall inherit all nations. [Is. 63:4]
